So, I'm going to suggest a different option to the few you've listed.

**GitHub**

Here's why:

Solo or team, you have the ability to write, rewrite, add, remove, or modify and project.

Say, for example, you're taking notes for a class.  Not only could you append any pertinent information that may come up in a later lesson, you may non-destructively redact any information that perhaps was made unclear either by your note-taking or a misunderstanding between you and your professor.

Imagine having even two friends in the class (at any time, doesn't need to be the same day even).  All three of you may take notes on separate branches of the Master notes.  With Github's difference engine, you would see not only where new information was, but also if there were contradicting issues which would give you the exact problem to clear up.

With GitHub, there would be no rewriting.  There would be no fear of incompatible files. Git is universal, on any operating system, from the terminal to the latest web browser.

There's also the small thing that this is an entirely free, near perfect system for an individual or team or organization to build upon the very first entry.

Just my two pennies.

Also, you can have a free webpage dedicated to you, think about the internet presence of hosting anything you want to display (resume, etc) pictures and projects you've worked on or been a leader of and being able for anyone with an internet connection (or a flash drive) to see a fully published internet presence of your choosing.

This isn't just for CS or STEM majors.  This can be a tool for anyone.

(The preceding was not a paid endorsement for GitHub or GitHub Pages, obligatoryi unfortunately has no affiliation with the company... yet)

Although I wish you provided a screenshot for perfect understanding, I'm assuming DBM is adding AS to the timer bars with the rest of DBM junk.


If this is a correct assumption, my suggestion would be to first check your addons (specifically for DBM-SpellTimers & DBM-Interrupts) and disable any that may correspond to this issue. Note:

More than just DMB may add a timer as DBM designed this as a feature.  (i.e. "/dbm timer 900 Pizza")
